remarks: Breathtaking Golf Course Views in a Premier 55+ Gated Community!    Location, location, location! Welcome to this beautiful, single-story home in the highly desirable Trilogy at Glen Ivy, a peaceful 55+ gated community offering resort-style living. Featuring 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, plus a versatile office or den, and 1,758 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, this home combines comfort, elegance, and spectacular golf course views. Step inside to an expansive, open-concept great room that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating a bright and airy atmosphere ideal for everyday living and entertaining.
